name: SolarWinds Incident Response
summary: SolarWinds Incident Response, previously sold as Squadcast, provides calendar-based on-call schedules, escalation policies, alert routing and a recorded incident timeline with a blameless postmortem template. Its pricing page lists the Pro plan at $15 per user a month billed annually and Premium at $24, with Enterprise by quote.

facts.text: The product page describes calendar-based on-call schedules with round-robin rotations, and multi-tier escalation policies with automatic failover.
The product page says each service generates a unique webhook integration URL for receiving alerts, and that live call routing pages high-severity incidents by phone.

The product page says the platform auto-captures the full incident timeline, covering alerts, acknowledgments, status changes and actions, and compiles it into a blameless postmortem template that teams can edit.
The product page names the product as SolarWinds Incident Response (previously Squadcast).
The pricing page lists Pro with postmortems with templates and schedules and escalations, and Premium with advanced escalations and exportable, editable incident timelines.
